claim.summary: Over any field, for P=sum_j q_j(x)(x_j^2-x_j), the class of q_j modulo all other Boolean equations is uniquely determined by P and represented by two successive divided differences in x_j at 0 and 1. A size-S depth-d division-free unbounded-fanin arithmetic circuit for P gives all v representatives in size O(v(S+1)^4), depth at most 4d+4, using the same field. These are representatives on coordinate lines, not a full correction tuple or multilinear normal forms in the remaining variables.
claim.assessment: Working monic-division and product-telescoping circuit argument, passed by the sole medium reviewer. No lower bound or generic canonicalization theorem.

claim.summary: For binary m-by-n A and n-by-m B, m>n>=1 and r=m-n, the formal residual P=product_(i,j)(1+delta_ij+(AB)_ij) vanishes after all but at most r individual entry variables are fixed to Boolean constants. A restriction leaving r+1 entries B_(n,j), j=n..m, free gives product_j t_j(1+t_j)^r, nonzero. Equivalently P lies in the ideal generated by products of r+1 distinct entry Boolean axioms, but not the analogous r+2 ideal; the witness also gives exact ordinary Boolean ideal order r+1. Every coefficient in every P=sum_j q_j(x)(x_j^2+x_j) is zero modulo all other Boolean equations. No circuit-size or PC-degree bound follows.
claim.assessment: Working sharp partial-coordinate and squarefree-support refinement of the recorded rank-residual order; passed by the sole medium reviewer. The coefficient conclusion is for the matching coordinate free and all other coordinates Boolean, not arbitrary parametrized lines.

claim.summary: In the binary m-by-n rank-residual setting, r=m-n>=1, every restriction fixing all but exactly r+1 individual entry variables to Boolean constants gives either zero residual or P_T=(product_(e in T)(t_e^2+t_e))*H_T. Since the residual is a product of degree-at-most-two factors, cancelling the distinct linear factors t_e and t_e+1 leaves a product of factors of degree at most two, size O(m^2 n) and constant depth. For any chosen e in T, P_T=(t_e^2+t_e)Q_e has such a small quotient, hence a one-coefficient formal Boolean correction. No global assembly at this cost is established.
claim.assessment: Working factor-cancellation consequence of the sharp coordinate-freedom theorem, proposed by the existing reviewer, verified by the author and passed by the same reviewer's follow-up. No global assembly at this cost is established.

claim.summary: Over any field, let literal CNF violation products F_i and all Boolean B_j=x_j^2-x_j have Hilbert-like certificate C(x,Y,Z), size S depth d. Put P=product_i(1-F_i), P_i=product_(k!=i)(1-F_k), and literal-telescoping T_i(x,B)=F_i^2-F_i. Then Q=C(x,(-P_i T_i(x,Z))_i,(P Z_j)_j) satisfies Q(x,B)=P, is Hilbert-like and has size O(S+s^3), depth<=d+10, s=m+n+literal length+1, counting gates and wires with unbounded fan-in. Conversely sum_i(product_(k<i)(1-F_k))Y_i+Q gives a certificate with fixed clause coefficients, size O(S+s^3), depth<=max(d,6)+2. Repeated, tautological and empty clauses allowed; polynomial Hilbert-likeness suffices.
claim.assessment: Working explicit formal transformation, medium reviewed. Extends the earlier selector identity by retaining and constructing Boolean corrections from the supplied certificate. Does not supply a certificate from nothing, preserve exact Frege simulation image or give a PC degree bound.

claim.summary: Replacing scalar oracle gates for Boolean-zero polynomials by zero preserves the Boolean function of any F2 sum/product circuit with binary constants, with no larger size/depth, including nested calls. Thus no uniformly fixed-depth poly(r)-size F2 scalar-oracle closure for all nonzero members of r-minor ideals can output det_floor(r^(1/3)) or any Frobenius power: use det_r(X)(x_11^2+x_11) and the recorded determinant-function bound. Moreover every complete linear Q(x,Z) with Q(x,b)=P for the binary rank residual is Boolean-zero: P in I^2 forces q_j(a)=partial_j P(a)=0. The obstruction covers black-box binary scalar extraction, not white-box transformations or extension-field circuits.
claim.assessment: Working elementary oracle-elimination corollary of the recorded Smolensky-based determinant-function reduction, passed by the same staged reviewer including the actual residual-certificate application. It does not contradict Dey-Guo/Andrews-Forbes large-field results or exclude their small-characteristic large-field extensions.
